issues.body: ReleaseGuiBundleWasmPackInstall reads and splits all of release.yml. test_matrix_still_has_arm64_rows searches cls.code globally, while _wasm_pack_steps discovers installer steps globally. Consequently, moving the taiki-e wasm-pack step to another job and leaving arm64 runner names elsewhere would satisfy these tests even though gui-bundle no longer installs wasm-pack. The test therefore does not enforce the stated invariant on the real protected job.
issues.fix_hint: Extract the gui-bundle job block first using an indentation-aware helper, then run the matrix-row checks and split_steps only over that job block. Add a mutation test that removes or moves the installer out of gui-bundle while retaining an equivalent wasm-pack step and arm64 strings in a sibling job, and assert that the guard fails.
issues.title: Release assertions are not scoped to the gui-bundle job

verdict.summary: The workflow change itself is plausible and the focused test suite passes, but the new release guard does not actually scope its evidence to the gui-bundle job. Its arm64 checks search the entire release workflow, and its wasm-pack-step discovery likewise searches every job. The test can therefore remain green after the installer is removed from gui-bundle, provided matching runner strings and a wasm-pack install-action step exist elsewhere. This makes the load-bearing regression test vacuous with respect to the job it claims to protect.
